newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia make promising start.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia make promising start.

text.p: South Australia have made a solid start to reach 98 for no wicket at lunch on the first day of their Sheffield Shield match against Tasmania.
Openers Ben Johnson and Martin Faull batted through the session after captain Jamie Siddons won the toss at Bellerive Oval.
Tasmania will move into second place in the Sheffield Shield standings behind Western Australia with an outright victory over the visitors, who prop up the table.
